sourceNotes.category: a house rule's name, split by the naming scheme's closed lists (policy/RuleNaming.json)
sourceNotes.fixKind: whether the rule's own tests show a fix, a suggestion, or both (examples/<rule>.json)
sourceNotes.language: the registry the row comes from: the Go engine's for TypeScript, swift/Rules.json for Swift
sourceNotes.messageIds: the message ids the rule's own tests assert (examples/<rule>.json)
sourceNotes.name: the rule registry (internal/lint/registry), as `cohere --rules` lists it
sourceNotes.namespace: the registered name, before its last slash
sourceNotes.options: the rule's registration: which decoder it carries and whether it requires options
sourceNotes.origin: for TypeScript, the registered namespace, and for a bare name the Go package that registers it; for Swift, the origin each rule declares (swift/Rules.json)
sourceNotes.sets: each carried rule set as the loader resolves it, at warn or error, top-level rules only
sourceNotes.typeAware: the rule's NeedsTypeChecker declaration, or for Swift the typeAware swift/Rules.json declares
sourceNotes.typeScriptRules: swift/HouseRuleVerdicts.json, read from the Swift side: the TypeScript rules whose verdict names this rule
sourceNotes.upstreamName: for TypeScript, the registered name, for a rule ported from a plugin or ESLint core; for Swift, the id a ported rule declares (swift/Rules.json)
